featuredLayouts.nome: Draft Data Primary Record Layout (Compra Clearing)
featuredLayouts.descricao: Registro primário de 168 bytes para apresentação financeira (First Presentment TC 05). Contém PAN, ARN de 23 dígitos, valores, MCC, código de autorização, POS Entry Mode e Reimbursement Attribute (posição 168).

featuredLayouts.nome: Draft Data Additional Data & Fee Program Indicator (FPI)
featuredLayouts.descricao: Segundo registro (TCR 1) do Draft Data. Carrega Chargeback Reduction Service, Fee Program Indicator (FPI nas posições 76–78), Card Acceptor ID (MID), Terminal ID e POS Environment.

featuredLayouts.nome: Brazil National Settlement Draft Data (Parcelado & Liquidação Nacional)
featuredLayouts.registro_filter: Brazil National Settlement Draft Data Record Layout
featuredLayouts.descricao: Registro específico do arranjo brasileiro (Country Code BR, TCR 2). Transporta o número de parcelas, número da parcela atual, tipo de parcelamento, taxa de embarque e dados de liquidação doméstica.

featuredLayouts.nome: Payment Service Data (Transaction ID, Validation Code, ECI & 3DS)
featuredLayouts.descricao: Registro crítico contra Downgrade de Intercâmbio (CPS/Custom Payment Service). Carrega o Transaction Identifier de 15 dígitos (pos 5–19), Validation Code (pos 24–27) e Electronic Commerce Indicator (ECI).

featuredLayouts.nome: Chip Card Transaction Data (EMV Cryptogram, TVR, IAD, ATC)
featuredLayouts.descricao: Dados criptográficos EMV do chip enviados no clearing (TCR 7): Application Transaction Counter (ATC), Terminal Verification Results (TVR), Application Cryptogram (ARQC/TC) e Issuer Application Data (IAD).

featuredLayouts.nome: VSS-120 / VSS-130 / VSS-140 Client Settlement Data (Intercâmbio & Tarifas)
featuredLayouts.registro_filter: TC 46, TCR 0 (Report Subgroup 4) Client Settlement Data Record Layout
featuredLayouts.descricao: Registro raw de conciliação financeira (TC 46 Subgroup 4) que alimenta os relatórios VSS-120, VSS-130 e VSS-140. Traz SRE de liquidação, moeda (986), contadores, montantes brutos e valores de Intercâmbio/Reimbursement Fees.

featuredLayouts.nome: VSS-Specific V22120 — Clearing & Settlement Detail Record
featuredLayouts.descricao: Layout posicional de 130 bytes dos registros analíticos V22120 gerados pelo Visa Settlement Service para batimento transacional de tarifas e intercâmbio.

featuredLayouts.nome: Table IP0040T1 — Issuer Account Range (Tabela de BINs & Produtos GCMS)
featuredLayouts.descricao: Principal tabela de parâmetros MPE da Mastercard (IP0040T1). Define faixas de BIN (Low/High de 19 dígitos), GCMS Product ID (ex: MCB,MPL,MDS), Card Program Identifier (CIR,MDS,Mestro), ICA do Emissor, País (BRA/076) e indicadores de ALM, Tokenização e Contactless.

featuredLayouts.nome: Table IP0052T1 — Interchange Fee Group (Regras de Enquadramento IRD)
featuredLayouts.descricao: Tabela MPE que amarra MTI (1240), Function Code (DE 24 = 200), Process Code (DE 3), Timeliness Pointer e Fee Code Pointer para determinar qual IRD (Interchange Rate Designator) será aplicado no clearing.

featuredLayouts.nome: Table IP0053T1 — Interchange Fee Type (Alíquotas %, Unit Fee e Limites)
featuredLayouts.descricao: Tabela MPE que armazena os percentuais de intercâmbio (Interchange Rate), tarifa fixa por transação (Unit Fee), direção do fluxo (A->I ou I->A), moeda (986) e piso/teto da tarifa.
Registro de detalhe do relatório IP755120-AA enviado pelo GCMS após cada ciclo de clearing (6 janelas diárias), detalhando lotes aceitos, contagens e valores de liquidação.

Registro posicional do arquivo de liquidação Elo (Release 26.2) que reporta transações cujo intercâmbio foi recalculado pela bandeira, exibindo Range de BIN, Valor da Transação, Taxa de Intercâmbio e o IRQ (Código de Classificação da Taxa nas posições 159–166).
Registro de Dados Suplementares (SDR) da Elo (Release 26.2), utilizado para transportar dados estendidos de marketplace, subcredenciadores, tokenização e dados setoriais.

fields.nome: Issuer card program identifier priority code
fields.descricao: The priority code assigned to the card program identifier by the issuer, for the associated account range. Priority codes begin with a low-value number for the highest priority and continue in ascending sequence. Priority code values are not always present in unbroken ascending sequence. The Dual Message Clearing System looks for the highest priority code value (lowest numerical value), and then the next highest priority, and so on. Member systems should not expect every account range to contain an entry with priority 01, or the priority codes to appear in an unbroken sequence

sampledCampos.nome: Issuer card program identifier priority code
sampledCampos.descricao: The priority code assigned to the card program identifier by the issuer, for the associated account range. Priority codes begin with a low-value number for the highest priority and continue in ascending sequence. Priority code values are not always present in unbroken ascending sequence. The Dual Message Clearing System looks for the highest priority code value (lowest numerical value), and then the next highest priority, and so on. Member systems should not expect every account range to contain an entry with priority 01, or the priority codes to appear in an unbroken sequence

sampledCampos.registro: TC 46, TCR 0 (Report Subgroup 6) Client Settlement Data Record Layout
sampledCampos.descricao: When the Report Identifier Suffix contains P or PS, this field contains the identification for the clearing identifier. For BASE II, the clearing identifier is the acquiring or issuing identifier that appears on the Edit Package Reports. For SMS, the clearing identifier is the Affiliate ID that appears on the detail reports and raw data; otherwise, this field contains a space. If the No Data Indicator = Y, this field contains a space.

sampledCampos.manual_titulo: VSS User Guide Vol. 2 (18 Apr 2026)
sampledCampos.registro: TC 46, TCR 0 (Report Subgroup 6) Client Settlement Data Record Layout
sampledCampos.descricao: This field contains the ISO numeric currency in which the amounts are reported. Possible values for this field are available in the BASE II Clearing Data Codes and in the VisaNet Authorization-Only Online Messages Technical Specifications manual. This field contains 000 if the transactions are nonfinancial. It contains a space if this is the total for all currency codes. If the No Data Indicator = Y, this field contains a space.

sampledCampos.manual_titulo: VSS User Guide Vol. 2 (18 Apr 2026)
sampledCampos.registro: TC 46, TCR 0 (Report Subgroup 6) Client Settlement Data Record Layout
sampledCampos.descricao: This field contains the 3-digit code that identifies the Settlement Service used. Possible values for this are included in VSS Codes. This field contains a space if this is the total for all Settlement Services. If the No Data Indicator = Y, this field contains a space.

sampledCampos.manual_titulo: VSS User Guide Vol. 2 (18 Apr 2026)
sampledCampos.registro: TC 46, TCR 0 (Report Subgroup 6) Client Settlement Data Record Layout
sampledCampos.descricao: Description: When Summary-Level contains 06, 07, or 08, the possible values for this field are: 1 = Acquirer 2 = Issuer 3 = Other 9 = Total Otherwise, this field contains a space. This code designates the type of value contained in the amount field. If the No Data Indicator = Y, this field contains a space.

sampledCampos.descricao: The possible values for this field are Y or space if there is no data for this report.

sampledCampos.descricao: This field is reserved for future use. EP will always space-fill.

sampledCampos.nome: Valores válidos: ‘00’ – 3DS 1.0.2 ou anterior, todos os métodos de autenticação ‘01’ – 3DS 2.01 Fluxo de Desafio utilizando código estático ‘02’ – 3DS 2.0 Fluxo de Desafio utilizando o método senha dinâmica por SMS (SMS OTP) ‘03’ – 3DS 2.0 Fluxo de Desafio utilizando o método senha dinâmica por token (OTP key fob) ‘04’ – 3DS 2.0 Fluxo de Desafio utilizando o método senha dinâmica por App (app OTP) ‘05’ – 3DS 2.0 Fluxo de Desafio utilizando o método senha dinâmica por E-mail (OTP other) ‘06’ – 3DS 2.0 Fluxo de Desafio utilizando o método de ‘knowledge-based authentication’ (KBA) ‘07’ – 3DS 2.0.1 Fluxo de Desafio utilizando o método de Autenticação Externa por Biometria (OOB Biometrics) ‘08’ – 3DS 2.0 Fluxo de Desafio utilizando o método de Autenticação Externa por Login (OOB Login) ‘09’ – 3DS 2.0 Fluxo de Desafio utilizando o método de Autenticação Externa por Outras formas (OOB Other) ‘10’ – 3DS 2.0 Fluxo de Desafio utilizando qualquer outro método de autenticação ‘11’ - 3DS 2.0 utilizando confirmação via push ‘12’ - 3DS 2.0 utilizando autenticação desacoplada ‘13’ - 3DS 2.0 utilizando WebAuthn ‘14’ - 3DS 2.0 utilizando SPC ‘15’ - 3DS 2.0 utilizando biometria comportamental ‘97’ – 3DS 2.0 Fluxo de Sem Atrito, revisão da Autenticação baseada em Risco (RBA) ‘98’ – 3DS 2.0 ACS de Tentativa da Elo respondendo ‘99’ – 3DS 2.0 Fluxo de Sem Atrito, Autenticação baseada em Risco (RBA)
